text:
noah: deploybot alerted a small but sustained error increase on the /rerank route after the 06:40 rollout. recommendation to rollback the route-only slice to v1.14.0. proposing targeted rollback + pin for 30m while we triage.

deploybot: Recommendation: route-only revert to v1.14.0 for /rerank (confidence 0.81). signals: route 5xx up 1.9% -> baseline 0.15%, p95 latency +80ms. Auto-action disabled (operators required).

tara: oncall. +1 for targeted route rollback. prefer 50% -> 100% staged shift to avoid queue buildup. also keep release-notes quiet until we confirm SLA impact.

noah: command I'll run:
```
redwoodctl traffic split --env prod --route rerank --from v1.15.2 --to v1.14.0 --pct-start 50 --pct-final 100 --step-interval 2m --reason "rerank route errors after rollout"
```

ben: looped in. Quick note: check model-run-timeout flag and kv-cache pressure; saw a small correlation on staging yesterday.

noah: kicking the job now.

deploybot: Action queued job_id=jb-88201. awaiting operator confirm.

tara: confirmed. starting step1. monitoring trace sampler and error logs.

deploybot: step1 complete: 50% -> v1.14.0. route 5xx dropped to 0.6%.

tara: proceeding to 100% early given improvement.

deploybot: shift complete: 100% rerank -> v1.14.0. p95 back to baseline.

noah: applying temporary pin and disabling auto-rollforward for rerank:
`redwoodctl pin --env prod --route rerank --version v1.14.0 --ttl 30m --reason "safety pin after rollback"`

comm-bot: Posted incident stub to #statuspage and queued customer note template "rerank-route-rollout-rollback".

ben: opening ticket INF-5667 and assigning to runtime. next steps: reproduce with the v1.15.2 change in staging, toggle model-run-timeout and kv-cache flags, run a canary with adjusted timeouts if we can reproduce.

tara: also disabling scheduled canary roll for v1.15.2 on the rerank route.

noah: draft internal release note: "Rerank route temporarily routed to v1.14.0 due to an observed uptick in 5xx/errors after v1.15.2 rollout. No customer data exposure. Investigating model timeout and kv-cache interactions."

comm-bot: Legal review requested for customer blurb.

noah: closing this thread for the execution portion. reopening when INF-5667 has RCA text. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
